notes: «وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ بِإِسْنَادِهِ»: the chain upstream of al-Sakuni is in an earlier report of the book and no previous report is supplied, so «بإسناده» is kept as the back reference
The Imam named after the chain: «أَمِيرَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ» is the last link (owner ruling 2); surface kept as written
